description: Offline seed sources for the hantavirus data collection workflow. These are used for deterministic source discovery before real web search is implemented.

seed_sources.title: About Hantavirus
seed_sources.source_purpose: General official background page for hantavirus disease.
seed_sources.notes: May not contain case counts, but useful for disease terminology and source grounding.

seed_sources.title: Reported Cases of Hantavirus Disease
seed_sources.source_purpose: Official U.S. reported hantavirus case data page.
seed_sources.notes: High-priority source for U.S. surveillance data.

seed_sources.title: Hantavirus Case Definition and Reporting
seed_sources.source_purpose: Official case definition and reporting guidance.
seed_sources.notes: Useful for interpreting case definitions and surveillance reporting.

seed_sources.title: Clinical Overview of Hantavirus
seed_sources.notes: May not contain case counts, but useful for terminology and disease definitions.

seed_sources.title: Hantavirus
seed_sources.notes: International organization source for disease background and terminology.

seed_sources.title: Hantavirus infection
seed_sources.source_purpose: ECDC topic page for hantavirus infection.
seed_sources.notes: Useful ECDC entry point for European hantavirus sources.

seed_sources.title: Factsheet on orthohantavirus infections
seed_sources.notes: Useful for case definition and European surveillance context.

seed_sources.title: Surveillance and updates for hantavirus
seed_sources.source_purpose: ECDC surveillance reports and annual epidemiological reports.
seed_sources.notes: High-priority source for European surveillance reports.

seed_sources.title: Hantavirus infection - Annual Epidemiological Report for 2023
seed_sources.source_purpose: ECDC annual epidemiological report with reported case data.
seed_sources.notes: Useful for testing source discovery and later extraction from official surveillance reports.

seed_sources.title: Hantavirus in the Americas: guidelines for prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and control
seed_sources.source_purpose: Regional PAHO/IRIS guidance on hantavirus in the Americas.
seed_sources.notes: May contain historical or guidance context; later screening should decide whether it contains extractable case or outbreak records.

seed_sources.title: PubMed search for hantavirus outbreak cases deaths
seed_sources.notes: This is a search endpoint, not a single source document. Later real search should replace this with article-level candidates.

seed_sources.title: Europe PMC search for hantavirus outbreak cases deaths
seed_sources.notes: This is a search endpoint, not a single source document. Later real search should replace this with article-level candidates.

seed_sources.title: OpenAlex search for hantavirus outbreak cases deaths
seed_sources.notes: This is a search endpoint, not a single source document. Later real search should replace this with article-level candidates.

seed_sources.title: Hantavirus surveillance dataset query
seed_sources.source_purpose: Placeholder seed for structured database discovery.
seed_sources.notes: Internal seed URI used to test structured database handling before real database connectors are implemented.

seed_sources.title: Hantavirus outbreak news and situation report query
seed_sources.source_purpose: Placeholder seed for news and situation report discovery.
seed_sources.notes: Internal seed URI used to test news/situation-report handling before real news search is implemented.
